findings_qualitative.value: Many disks have cold massive outer disks partly shadowed by a tall, gas-rich inner disk; classical dust masses can be wrong.

evidence.quote: Our analysis shows a number of Herbig Ae and T Tauri stars with very cold and massive outer disks which are situated at least partly in the shadow of a tall and gas-rich inner disk.
